scientific_question: After a traceable surface NH4-N aqueous pool dries to loss of explicit aqueous storage, what fraction and time course of retained N returns to surface aqueous NH4-N when water returns, and what fraction remains retained, enters soil/mineral storage, or leaves as gaseous N?
candidate_prediction: At the first experimentally resolvable post-rewetting state all retained continuation N is in surface aqueous NH4-N, with no material delayed release, competing soil/mineral receiver, gaseous loss attributable to rewetting, or terminal non-aqueous residue.
operational_instantaneous_rule: Instantaneous is evaluated at the predeclared earliest defensible sampling resolution; SQ11 sets no universal time threshold.

competing_hypotheses.H_DELAYED: later aqueous recovery increases from a retained pool
competing_hypotheses.H_SOIL_RECEIVER: material N enters a quantified soil/mineral receiver
competing_hypotheses.H_GAS_LOSS: material N leaves as NH3 during dry-down or rewetting
competing_hypotheses.H_OTHER_RETAINED: material non-aqueous N remains after rewetting

stage_A.name: ISOLATED_INERT_SURFACE
stage_A.purpose: Separate residue formation and rewetting from soil/mineral receiver ambiguity.
required: traceable NH4-N source and counter-ion composition
documented dry endpoint with no explicit aqueous storage
NH3 loss measured or tightly bounded
predeclared rewetting water amount and composition
full N mass closure with uncertainty

stage_B.name: SURFACE_SOIL_OR_MINERAL_CONTACT
stage_B.purpose: Test for a competing receiver under representative contact.
required: same source and dry-down bookkeeping as Stage A
NH3 loss measured or tightly bounded
full N mass closure with uncertainty

tracer.reason: Improves attribution against background N, especially in Stage B and gas capture.

experimental_architecture.replication_rule: The executing laboratory must predeclare replication/randomization from pilot variance, analytical precision and power target. SQ11 has no evidence basis for a universal numeric n.

decision_rules.uncertainty: Use predeclared combined measurement uncertainty and method quantification limits; no arbitrary universal epsilon is introduced.
support_M1: first resolvable aqueous recovery is compatible with complete recovery
soil/mineral receiver absent or bounded within the uncertainty/quantification envelope
rewetting gaseous loss absent or bounded within the uncertainty/quantification envelope
terminal non-aqueous retained N absent or bounded within the uncertainty/quantification envelope
mass closure passes the predeclared analytical criterion
material characterization supports a traceable mapping for the tested residue
refute_M1_for_tested_condition: first-sample aqueous recovery materially below complete recovery after measured sinks
inconclusive: sampling too coarse to distinguish finite-rate release
unmeasured receiver or gas term that is not tightly bounded
decision_rules.scope_limit: A pass supports only the tested material and application envelope and cannot by itself establish a universal ANIMO constitutive law.

evidence_package.raw_data: immutable raw observations or governance-approved immutable external reference
evidence_package.provenance: sample lineage, lab/operator identity, dates and source-material traceability
evidence_package.uncertainty: reported for measurements and derived fractions
evidence_package.negative_results: retained; failed/inconclusive runs may not be silently excluded
